notes: Verified from official LATAM Pass product page. This entry is for the base (non-elite) LATAM Airlines Mastercard variant with no annual fee. The page also lists a World Elite Mastercard variant ($99 annual fee, us-first-latam-airlines). Products and services are serviced by Cardless, Inc.; cards issued by First Electronic Bank. Lounge access, cabin upgrades, and courtesy segments are exclusive to World Elite cardholders. APR not visible on page; see Rates and Fees disclosure.
